appMenu.lightModeDetail: Switches the app to the light look

comparisonPage.title: Answer comparison
comparisonPage.description: How the parties answered each question

comparisonPane.majorityNote: The mark shows how the majority of this party's councillors voted.
comparisonPane.majorityTally: {agreeing} of {total} councillors voted the same way

guidePage.title: How it works
guidePage.description: Try it on a practice card — nothing from it counts anywhere.

guidePractice.bodyTouch: Drag the card in the marked directions, or tap one of the options.
guidePractice.bodyPointer: Drag the card in the marked directions, or click one of the options.
guidePractice.feedbackImportant: Important to me — such a question counts double in the result.
guidePractice.feedbackSkip: Skipped — it doesn't count towards the result.
guidePractice.done: You've got the hang of it. Let's start for real.

guideSteps.agreeDescriptionTouch: Drag the card left, or tap Yes.
guideSteps.agreeDescriptionPointer: Drag the card left, press the left arrow, or click Yes.
guideSteps.disagreeDescriptionTouch: Drag the card right, or tap No.
guideSteps.disagreeDescriptionPointer: Drag the card right, press the right arrow, or click No.
guideSteps.importantDescriptionTouch: Drag the card diagonally up, or tap the star. A starred question counts double in the result.
guideSteps.importantDescriptionPointer: Drag the card diagonally up, press the up arrow, or click the star. A starred question counts double in the result.
guideSteps.skipDescriptionTouch: Drag a question you don't want to answer down — it doesn't count towards the result.
guideSteps.skipDescriptionPointer: Drag a question you don't want to answer down or press the down arrow — it doesn't count towards the result.
guideSteps.recapDescription: At the end you'll see all the questions together and can still change your answers.

introductionPage.description: Answer {count, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}} and see who you are closest to.
introductionPage.candidates: Comparing {count, plural, one {# candidate} other {# candidates}}.
introductionPage.factImportantDescription: You can mark a question you particularly care about as important. It then counts double in the result.
introductionPage.factSkipDescription: You don't have to answer everything. A skipped question doesn't count towards the result.
introductionPage.factRecapDescription: At the end you'll see all the questions together and can still change your answers.

leaveDialog.title: Leave the calculator?
leaveDialog.description: Your answers are saved as you go, so you can come back in this browser and pick up where you left off. In a private window, though, they are lost once it's closed.

restartDialog.title: Start over?
restartDialog.description: We'll delete all your answers in this calculator and take you back to the first question. This can't be undone.

resultPage.listHintPeople: Tap a candidate to compare your answers
resultPage.sharedNote: Someone shared this result with you. Your own answers stay untouched.
resultPage.emptyDescription: Answer at least one question and your match will appear here.
resultPage.expertNote: Positions taken from public sources; the party did not answer the questions sent to it.
